connection.title: Which Connection did this file come through?
connection.description: The Connection's CSV mapping reads the file.
connection.noneTitle: This Account has no Connection yet
connection.noneBody: A Connection tells Wallet Accountant how your bank's statement files are laid out.

file.title: Statement file and Export balance
file.description: Use the file as your bank exported it.
file.dropZone: Drop the statement file here, or choose one
file.fileEmpty: This file is empty. Export the statement again from your bank.
file.exportBalanceHelp: Your bank's booked balance when you exported this file, in {{currency}}. Leave out card payments still marked as pending.
file.confirmationHelp: Type it again rather than pasting it: on the first import it sets the Opening balance.

preview.title: Check the Opening balance
preview.description: Nothing is recorded until you confirm.
preview.noRows: No rows on or after the start date: the Opening balance equals the Export balance.
preview.ignoredNote_one: {{count}} row is before the Account's start date of {{date}}, so it isn't imported.
preview.ignoredNote_other: {{count}} rows are before the Account's start date of {{date}}, so they aren't imported.
preview.closedNote_one: {{count}} row is booked in a closed month, so it isn't imported.
preview.closedNote_other: {{count}} rows are booked in closed months, so they aren't imported.

checks.WAITING: Waiting — decide the Suspected duplicates to finish the Balance check

refusal.balanceHint: Likely causes: the Export balance was mistyped; a card payment still pending was counted in; the file leaves a gap since the last import; or the mapping reads the amounts with the wrong sign.

list.title: Statement imports
list.empty: No Statement imports yet. Import a statement file to bring in its rows.
list.failedHint: Void it and import a corrected file.

blocked.NOT_LATEST: Only the latest import can be voided.
blocked.HAS_ACCEPTED_ROWS: Some of its rows are Accepted.
blocked.TOUCHES_CLOSED_MONTH: It has rows in a closed month.

void.body: Its Imported transactions become Discarded and the file can be imported again.
void.bodyFirst: It's this Account's first import, so its Opening balance is reversed too and the Account will await its first Statement import again.
